items.resolution: W81 proves non-fee Research-to-W78 execution-cost continuity from the observed midpoint using the exact preregistered Research half-spread plus slippage target and exact W78 multiplicative side-aware execution impact. Favorable observations that reduce effective friction are BLOCKED. A promotion blocker may be removed only by a hash-bound resolution tied to the exact W80 candidate assessment and its EXECUTION_SENSITIVITY measurement, with temporal provenance. Fee accounting, strategy-version execution binding, shadow/forward promotion binding and partial-fill reservation remain separate blockers. No compatible external PAPER execution-price receipt is fabricated; any future PAPER adapter must be read-only and identity-bound.
items.next_action: Maintain W81 boundaries permanently. If a future authoritative PAPER execution-price source contains exact account/order/strategy/symbol identity, attach it through a separately reviewed read-only adapter; never substitute unrelated first-canary position truth. Fee-complete deterministic qualification accounting is handled by W82 / TD-R7D-002.

items.area: Fee-complete execution accounting before profitability or Auto-Paper promotion claims
items.resolution: W82 closes fee completeness for deterministic candidate qualification without changing canonical Fill or fabricating broker activity. Base simulated fee accounting is hash-bound to the exact Research fee assumption, W78 measurement universe and W81 continuity; a separate product-economics layer applies literal charge semantics; and final blocker removal additionally requires a fresh versioned documented Alpaca crypto fee-schedule attestation. The canonical qualification venue is alpaca-paper-model. The current conservative unknown-volume/no-maker-guarantee baseline is 25 bps, from documented Tier-1 15 bps maker / 25 bps taker fees. The final resolver additionally requires RECEIVED_ASSET_PERCENT charge convention and WORST_CASE liquidity role, so a caller-defined local policy, a non-Alpaca venue, or a validly rehashed receipt with different charge/liquidity semantics cannot remove the blocker. The documentation snapshot has a fixed verification timestamp and expires after 30 days. PAPER fee activity remains PENDING with fee_amount=null and zero_fee_inferred=false until an audited read-only broker source exists. Therefore broker_authoritative_fee_proven=false and realized_profitability_authorized=false remain mandatory; W82 proves conservative deterministic qualification economics, not an actually debited Alpaca fee or future profitability.
items.next_action: Maintain W82 fee/accounting/product/schedule/resolution boundaries permanently. Re-verify and version the Alpaca fee schedule snapshot before its 30-day expiry. Any lower fee floor requires separately certified evidence of the applicable account volume tier and liquidity role; any realized-fee claim requires an audited read-only broker fee-activity source with exact provenance. Continue with W83 execution-strategy-version binding; do not promote Auto-Paper while EXECUTION_STRATEGY_VERSION_UNBOUND or SHADOW_FORWARD_PROMOTION_BINDING_REQUIRED remains.

Before repeated Auto-Paper partial-fill activity, replace conservative full OPEN reservation retention only if the system can bind the reduced reservation to authoritative remaining broker-open quantity. The change must preserve cross-process race safety, fill projection, cancellation/replacement semantics and reconciliation. Over-reservation is acceptable until that proof exists; premature capital release is not.
